# Protocol source attribution

These protocol helpers were adapted from the official Happier repository:
https://github.com/happier-dev/happier/tree/e992e049ffa7a98ab60740ac60f94918f022ff24

Files: terminalProvisioningV2.ts, boxBundle.ts, canonicalDigest.ts,
encryptedDataKeyEnvelopeV1.ts, base64.ts, serializedJsonValue.ts.

The browser bundle also includes dependencies whose notices are emitted in
dashboard/happier-cloud.js.LEGAL.txt. This directory is build input only and is
excluded from Firebase Hosting.
